nuggets.text: Tim Albin turns 61 on Sunday, the day after the 49ers play at Ole Miss.
Tim Albin coached his alma mater, Northwestern Oklahoma State, to a 13-0 season and an NAIA national title in 1999.
Tim Albin led Ohio to the 2024 MAC title, the Bobcats' first since 1968, and was hired by Charlotte right after.
Cole Gonzales was the 2023 SoCon Offensive Player of the Year at Western Carolina and a two-time Walter Payton Award finalist.
Cole Gonzales threw three touchdown passes and ran for two more scores in the 49ers' season opener.
Khamani Alexander's 66-yard touchdown run in the opener was the 49ers' longest scoring play from scrimmage since 2024.
The 49ers name honors 1949, when Bonnie Cone saved the school's forerunner from being shut down by the state.
Cole Gonzales went from Western Carolina to Oklahoma to Pitt before becoming the 49ers' starting quarterback.
The 49ers' season opener was the first triple-overtime game in program history.
Saturday is the first meeting ever between the 49ers and Ole Miss.
